name: 세케트
silhouette: 커다란 외눈, 하단이 흩어지는 유령 형태, 중심부의 밝은 빛
signature_motion: 플레이어를 향해 몸을 길게 늘리며 돌진함
signature_vfx: 중심에서 뻗어 나오는 형광 연두색의 소용돌이 파동
micro_features: 몸 주변을 떠도는 작은 안개 입자
visual_en: A floating ghost entity facing right, featuring a single large eye with a glowing neon lime green pupil. The upper body is a semi-transparent midnight blue and deep violet mass, while the lower body dissolves into wispy, dark lavender smoke. A bright neon lime green core glows intensely at the center of its eye and torso. A small silver bell hangs loosely around its neck, and tiny fragments of light drift around the trailing smoke tail.
pose_en: Floating eerily while leaning forward as if lunging.
vfx_en: Swirling ripples of neon lime green energy expanding outward.
motion_en: Lunging forward with a stretching, spectral movement
lore: 가까이 오면 플레이어를 자기 쪽으로 끌어당긴다.

anim_notes.skill: pulling the target toward itself with a strong dragging force
